description: This is a PHP source file that defines the SubTotal class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends a system model and includes a method to calculate and add the subtotal (including vouchers) to the total amount, for use in the total order calculation process.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Represents the SubTotal calculation component within the OpenCart total extension module.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of the cart, including vouchers, and appends the subtotal detail to the totals array, also updating the overall total.
